name: DHR ICMR BRET
desc: Biomedical Research Eligibility Test for DHR-ICMR JRF
syllabus_summary: Covers General Aptitude and Scientific Reasoning (Section A), General/Interdisciplinary Knowledge (Section B), and Subject Domain Knowledge in Life Sciences, Biomedical Sciences, or Social Sciences (Section C).

name: IIT JAM Biotechnology (BT)
desc: M.Sc / Joint M.Sc-PhD at IITs & IISc (Min 55% in B.Sc/B.Tech with 10+2 Biology/Maths)
syllabus_summary: Official website to be announced.

name: GATE Chemical Engineering (CH)
desc: M.Tech / PhD in Chemical/Polymer Engineering & PSU Jobs
syllabus_summary: Covers Engineering Mathematics, Process Calculations, Thermodynamics, Fluid Mechanics, Heat Transfer, Mass Transfer, Chemical Reaction Engineering, Process Control, Plant Design, and Chemical Technology.

name: AAI Junior Executive
desc: Airports Authority of India - Junior Executive (ATC, IT, Architecture, Engineering, etc). Eligibility: B.E/B.Tech, MBA, or B.Sc (Physics/Math)
syllabus_summary: Covers General Intelligence, Reasoning, Numerical Ability, General Awareness, English Language, and discipline-specific technical domain subjects such as Physics and Mathematics for ATC.

name: AAI ATC
desc: Airports Authority of India - Air Traffic Controller. Eligibility: B.Sc Physics/Maths or B.Tech (Min 60%). Age: 18-27.
syllabus_summary: Covers Physics, Mathematics, English, General Intelligence, and Air Traffic Control domain knowledge.

name: GATE Biotechnology (BT)
desc: M.Tech / PhD in Biotech & PSU Jobs
syllabus_summary: Covers Engineering Mathematics, General Biology, Genetics, Cell and Molecular Biology, Fundamentals of Biological Engineering, Bioprocess Engineering, Recombinant DNA Technology, and Bioinformatics.

name: GATE Life Sciences (XL)
syllabus_summary: Covers Chemistry (Compulsory) along with elective sections in Biochemistry, Botany, Microbiology, Zoology, and Food Technology.

name: GATE Ecology & Evolution (EY)
syllabus_summary: Covers Ecology, Evolution, Behavioural Ecology, Applied Ecology, Quantitative Ecology, and Evolutionary Genetics.

name: GATE Computer Science (CS)
desc: M.Tech / PhD in CS & PSU Jobs
syllabus_summary: Covers Discrete Mathematics, Engineering Mathematics, Digital Logic, Computer Organization, Programming and Data Structures, Algorithms, Theory of Computation, Compiler Design, Operating Systems, Databases, and Computer Networks.

name: GATE Data Science & AI (DA)
syllabus_summary: Covers Probability and Statistics, Linear Algebra, Calculus and Optimization, Programming, Data Structures and Algorithms, Database Management and Warehousing, Machine Learning, and Artificial Intelligence.

name: GATE Mechanical (ME)
syllabus_summary: Covers Engineering Mathematics, Applied Mechanics and Design, Fluid Mechanics and Thermal Sciences, and Materials, Manufacturing and Industrial Engineering.

name: GATE Production & Industrial (PI)
syllabus_summary: Covers Engineering Mathematics, General Engineering, Manufacturing Processes, Quality and Reliability, Operations Research, and Industrial Engineering.

name: GATE Engineering Sciences (XE)
syllabus_summary: Covers Engineering Mathematics (Compulsory) and choice of two subjects among Fluid Mechanics, Materials Science, Solid Mechanics, Thermodynamics, Polymer Science, Food Technology, and Atmospheric Sciences.

name: GATE Civil Engineering (CE)
syllabus_summary: Covers Engineering Mathematics, Structural Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Water Resources Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Transportation Engineering, and Geomatics Engineering.

name: GATE Environmental Science (ES)
syllabus_summary: Covers Mathematics Foundation, Environmental Chemistry, Environmental Microbiology, Water and Wastewater Engineering, Air Pollution and Control, Solid and Hazardous Waste Management, and Environmental Management.

name: GATE Electrical Engineering (EE)
syllabus_summary: Covers Engineering Mathematics, Electric Circuits, Electromagnetic Fields, Signals and Systems, Electrical Machines, Power Systems, Control Systems, Electrical Measurements, Analog and Digital Electronics, and Power Electronics.

name: GATE Electronics & Comm. (EC)
syllabus_summary: Covers Engineering Mathematics, Networks, Signals and Systems, Electronic Devices, Analog Circuits, Digital Circuits, Control Systems, Communications, and Electromagnetics.

name: GATE Instrumentation (IN)
syllabus_summary: Covers Engineering Mathematics, Electricity and Magnetism, Signals and Systems, Transducers and Optical Instrumentation, Analog and Digital Electronics, Control Systems, Measurements, and Process Control.

name: GATE Statistics (ST)
syllabus_summary: Covers Calculus, Matrix Theory, Probability, Standard Distributions, Stochastic Processes, Estimation, Testing of Hypotheses, Non-parametric Tests, Multivariate Analysis, and Regression Analysis.

name: GATE Mathematics (MA)
syllabus_summary: Covers Calculus, Linear Algebra, Real Analysis, Complex Analysis, Ordinary and Partial Differential Equations, Algebra, Functional Analysis, Numerical Analysis, Topology, and Linear Programming.

name: GATE Physics (PH)
syllabus_summary: Covers Mathematical Physics, Classical Mechanics, Electromagnetic Theory, Quantum Mechanics, Thermodynamics and Statistical Physics, Atomic and Molecular Physics, Solid State Physics, Nuclear and Particle Physics, and Electronics.

name: GATE Chemistry (CY)
syllabus_summary: Covers Physical Chemistry (Structure, Equilibrium, Kinetics), Inorganic Chemistry (Main group, Transition Metals, Organometallics), and Organic Chemistry (Stereochemistry, Reaction Mechanisms, Synthesis, Biomolecules).

name: CSIR UGC NET
syllabus_summary: Covers General Aptitude (Part A) and advanced domain knowledge (Part B and C) across Chemical Sciences, Earth Sciences, Life Sciences, Mathematical Sciences, and Physical Sciences.

name: UGC NET
syllabus_summary: Covers Paper 1 (General Paper on Teaching and Research Aptitude, Reasoning, ICT, Higher Education System) and Paper 2 (Elective subject-specific postgraduate discipline).

name: VITMEE
syllabus_summary: Covers discipline-specific core engineering or computer application subjects for M.Tech/MCA admissions alongside English Communication Skills.

name: UPSC IES / ESE
syllabus_summary: Covers General Studies and Engineering Aptitude (Stage-I Paper 1) and core engineering discipline subjects (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or Electronics and Telecommunication) for Prelims and Mains.

name: TIFR GS / JGEEBILS
desc: PhD at TIFR / Biology Research PhD
syllabus_summary: Evaluates basic scientific knowledge across General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Math), Biology (Cell/Molecular Biology, Genetics, Biochemistry), and scientific reasoning.

name: GAT-B
syllabus_summary: Covers 10+2 level Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and Biology (Section A) and Bachelor's level Basic Biology, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, and allied areas (Section B).

name: GPAT
desc: Gateway for M.Pharm and NIPER JEE eligibility
syllabus_summary: Covers core B.Pharm subjects including Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Pharmacognosy, Pharmacology, and allied pharmaceutical science disciplines.

name: NIPER JEE
syllabus_summary: Covers B.Pharm core curriculum including Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Analysis, Pharmacology and Toxicology, Medicinal Chemistry, and Natural Products alongside General Aptitude.

name: BARC OCES/DGFS
desc: Scientific Officer at BARC (Min 60% in B.Tech/B.Sc/M.Sc, Max Age: 26)
syllabus_summary: Covers core engineering or science subject knowledge at the graduate/postgraduate level corresponding to the candidate's specific discipline.

name: UPSC Civil Services (CSE)
syllabus_summary: Covers General Studies (Prelims and Mains Papers I-IV), CSAT Paper II, Essay, and optional subject discipline alongside qualifying language papers.

name: SBI PO
desc: Probationary Officer in State Bank of India
syllabus_summary: Covers Reasoning Ability, Quantitative Aptitude, English Language, General/Economy/Banking Awareness, and Data Analysis and Interpretation across Prelims and Mains.

name: IBPS PO
desc: Probationary Officer in Public Sector Banks
syllabus_summary: Covers Reasoning Ability and Computer Aptitude, Quantitative Aptitude and Data Interpretation, General/Economy/Banking Awareness, and English Language including Descriptive Writing.
dateStr: Admit Card Released! Exam Date: August 22, 2026

name: RRB NTPC (Graduate Posts)
syllabus_summary: Covers General Awareness, Mathematics, and General Intelligence and Reasoning across CBT-1 and CBT-2 for graduate-level railway posts.

name: RRB NTPC (Undergraduate Posts)
syllabus_summary: Covers General Awareness, Mathematics, and General Intelligence and Reasoning across CBT-1 and CBT-2 for undergraduate-level railway posts.

name: SSC CHSL
desc: Lower Division Clerk, Data Entry Operator
syllabus_summary: Covers General Intelligence, English Language, Quantitative Aptitude, and General Awareness across Tier 1 and Tier 2 for 10+2 posts.

name: IB ACIO
syllabus_summary: Covers Current Affairs, General Studies, Numerical Aptitude, Reasoning and Logical Aptitude, and English Language in Tier 1, plus Essay Writing and Comprehension in Tier 2.

name: SSC CGL
syllabus_summary: Covers General Intelligence and Reasoning, General Awareness, Quantitative Aptitude, and English Comprehension across Tier 1 and Tier 2 for graduate-level posts.

name: CTET
desc: Eligibility for Central Government Teaching Jobs
syllabus_summary: Covers Child Development and Pedagogy, Language I, Language II, Mathematics, Environmental Studies (Paper I) and Science and Mathematics or Social Studies (Paper II).

name: ATMA (AIMS Test for Management Admissions)
syllabus_summary: Covers Analytical Reasoning Skills, Verbal Skills, and Quantitative Skills divided across six timed sections.
